changes: Updates to the author's Octatrick 2.21: chords on the chromatic keys keep their notes with a scale, and the first chord after power-on in a saved project plays as a chord.
Step and scene locks on every FM control, a selection guard and voice cap per Part; fixes #557 (click), #710 (first-trig envelope) and #751 (CHRD scene).
LFOs and scene locks on AMP ATK, HOLD and REL shape the sound; an LFO on PTCH moves the pitch as on FLEX (Jan Kolkmeier's #883 / #884). The SRC page is out of the DELAY's table tail (#895).
The bundled scale quantizer follows the scale on FM tracks; MIDI tracks are Scale Quantizer's (#555). SEQUENCER shows SCALE, ROOT and GLIDE. About 12 dB louder than 0.1.2.
Compatibility: Scale Quantizer is a declared conflict (FM Synth bundles its own quantizer). An FM track's level no longer follows its slot's GAIN attribute. LFO SETUP shows FM's names (#589)
